Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve a Digimon in the breeding area, does that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect trigger?

Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

If an opponent's Digimon is attacking and another effect digivolves one of my Digimon into this card, does that meet the "if during an attack" condition in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if during an attack, 1 of your Digimon in the breeding area may digivolve into a level 6 or lower [Chronicle] trait Digimon card in the hand or trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once per Turn] When security stacks are removed from, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon is [Alphamon: Ouryuken], trash your opponent's top security card.
